topic: Talking to a Neighbor About the Lawn

script.title: THE HEDGE NEXT DOOR
script.story_hook: A friendly fence chat about a messy hedge.
script.intro_zh: 隔著圍牆，兩位鄰居友好地聊起樹籬。
script.welcome_en: Hey there, neighbor friend! Today it's a little lawn chat.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，鄰居朋友！今天是一場小小的草坪閒聊。
script.outro: Friendly fences make good neighbors! Keep listening, see you soon.
script.outro_zh: 圍牆友善，鄰居也好！繼續多聽，我們一會兒再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, echo every line back to me, friend.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，請把每一句跟著我重複一次，朋友。
script.char_a_description: a sturdy woman in her fifties with an asymmetric honey bob, wearing khaki gardening shorts, muddy knee pads, and thick leather gloves tucked under one arm
script.char_b_description: a ruddy man in his seventies with a bushy white mustache and a faded flat cap, wearing checked overalls with one strap loose, pruning shears in his hand
script.youtube_title: 【🌿跟鄰居聊樹籬】「是我的錯」超有禮貌的說法！18句院內閒聊🎧聽完就敢開口💡｜🌱A2初級｜Neighbor Chat English
script.youtube_title_en: "That's My Bad" — Talking to a Neighbor About the Lawn

script.youtube_description_en:
Hedge clippings landing all over your lawn? Here is the friendly, zero-drama way to raise it in English. Follow Rosa and Walter at the fence line as she names the problem, he owns it, and they plan a windy-day fix together — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🌿鄰居草坪英文｜說明碎葉・禮貌承認・相約修剪｜聽完就會好溝通｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
鄰居的樹籬碎葉掉滿你的草坪，該不該開口？
怎麼說才不會傷了和氣？

這一集帶大家走進週日上午的前院籬笆邊，跟著 Rosa 從禮貌提出碎葉問題、聽 Walter 坦率承認、約好起風前修剪，到一起用落葉吹風機清理邊界，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🍂 提出狀況：例如「Well, the clippings land all over my lawn.」。
🙏 坦率道歉：例如「That's my bad, I trim it leaning left.」。
🤝 相約解決：例如「Want me to rake your edge that week?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次隔著籬笆遇見鄰居，你也能把小問題聊成好心情！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey neighbor! Quick question about your hedge.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ˈneɪbər kwɪk ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt jɔr hɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，鄰居！想請問一下你家樹籬的小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh hi! What's wrong with my hedge, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ haɪ wʌts rɔŋ wɪð maɪ hɛdʒ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我家樹籬到底怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the clippings land all over my lawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈklɪpɪŋz lænd ɔl ˈoʊvər maɪ lɔn/
dialogue.zh: 呃，剪下來的碎葉掉滿我的草坪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, I had no idea! Which side is worst?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ aɪ hæd noʊ aɪˈdiə wɪtʃ saɪd ɪz wɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 啊，我真的一點都不知道！哪邊最嚴重？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back corner, right above my fence line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ˈkɔrnər raɪt əˈbʌv maɪ fɛns laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 後面那個角落，就在圍牆上方那一帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my bad, I trim it leaning left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ bæd aɪ trɪm ɪt ˈlinɪŋ lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 那是我的錯，我修剪時都往左邊站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No big deal, I just wanted to ask nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɪɡ dil aɪ dʒʌst ˈwɑntəd tə æsk ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼大事，我就是想好好地詢問一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I really appreciate you telling me, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈrɪli əˈpriʃieɪt ju ˈtɛlɪŋ mi ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 很謝謝你願意直接告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So maybe trim it before the windy afternoons?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmeɪbi trɪm ɪt bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈwɪndi ˈæftərˌnunz/
dialogue.zh: 那也許可以趁下午起風之前先修剪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call! Saturdays, the breeze pushes it over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ˈsætəˌdeɪz ðə briz ˈpʊʃɪz ɪt ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 好建議！週六的微風總是把它吹到你那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly! And your big oak drops leaves in October.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ænd jɔr bɪɡ oʊk drɑps livz ɪn ɑkˈtoʊbər/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣！你家大橡樹十月也掉葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True! Want me to rake your edge that week?
dialogue.phonetic: /tru wɑn mi tə reɪk jɔr ɛdʒ ðæt wik/
dialogue.zh: 對喔！那一週要我幫你把邊界耙一耙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That'd be lovely, but don't overwork yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðætd bi ˈlʌvli bət doʊt ˈoʊvɜrk ˌjʊrˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那太美好了，但也別把自己累壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nah, easy — I got a fancy new leaf blower.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑ ˈizi aɪ ɡɑt ə ˈfænsi nu lif ˈbloʊər/
dialogue.zh: 沒那麼難啦——我剛買了新型的落葉吹風機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! My dog chased one right off the porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪ dɔɡ tʃeɪst wʌn raɪt ɔf ðə pɔrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我家狗上次把吹風機追到門廊外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair trade! Neighbors gotta help neighbors, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr treɪd ˈneɪbərz ˈɡɔtə hɛlp ˈneɪbərz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太划算了！鄰居就是要互相幫忙，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! I'll bring a bag for the clippings, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl brɪŋ ə bæɡ fɔr ðə ˈklɪpɪŋz tu/
dialogue.zh: 成交！我也會帶袋子來裝那些碎葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. See you Saturday, neighbor. Bye!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。週六見，鄰居！再見啦。
